lesson: When a fixed arithmetic target has no safe target-domain DifferenceWitness, an exact arithmetic surrogate family can still be useful if (i) it realizes arbitrarily long target prefixes, (ii) the target functional has a uniform summable-tail stability bound, and (iii) the same surrogate instance carries both the local realization and the global certificate. Do not glue these conditions across different instances.
scope: Search/routing heuristic for tail-stable arithmetic functionals; no theorem or method authority.
